trajectory_summary: This call opens cold and never builds — the rep short-circuits her own qualification process by disqualifying the lead off a visual satellite impression within two minutes, then compounds it by placing the customer on hold to consult a supervisor rather than continuing the conversation. The customer pushes back three separate times with specific, reasonable counter-evidence about her actual sun exposure, and the rep never pivots to the obvious resolution — routing to a specialist for an on-site look — instead closing the call with a well-wish.
outcome_dispute: V1 outcome context is unclear, but this should be recorded as a DQ initiated entirely by the rep's satellite-imagery read, not a customer-driven disqualification. The customer never said solar wouldn't work for her — she actively argued the opposite three times. This is a premature/rep-driven DQ, not a clean hard-gate failure like roof age or non-ownership.

observed_outcome.quote: I really wouldn't recommend solar panels for your home
observed_outcome.reasoning: The call ends with no appointment and no next step; the rep disqualified the lead based on tree/shading concerns from satellite imagery, though the customer contested this disqualification with specific counter-evidence multiple times without resolution.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: The rep never reached the bill/utility portion of the verify script — the call was diverted into the roof/tree DQ discussion within the first two minutes and never returned to bill or utility questions.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: The rep never asked what interested the customer in solar. The customer's original form ('looking for some changes to my house') was acknowledged at 00:58 but never explored further before the rep moved to address/roof verification and then the DQ.

primary_coaching_focus.topic: premature DQ from satellite imagery, skipping verify section
primary_coaching_focus.quote: I really wouldn't recommend solar panels for your home
primary_coaching_focus.why: The rep disqualifies the lead within two minutes based solely on a visual satellite impression, before asking a single verify-section question (interest, bill, roof type/age) and without testing her read against the customer's own account of her sun exposure. This is the single highest-leverage fix — the rep needs a rule that satellite imagery informs but does not decide a DQ, and that customer-reported sun exposure gets tested (or routed to a specialist) before a DQ is delivered.

key_moments.quote: You talk so fast. I can't understand you.
key_moments.stewart_read: This is a first-30-seconds legitimacy/rapport signal — the customer can't process the intro because the rep's pace doesn't match her tempo. The schema flags energy match (calm, neighbor-like pace, 140-170 wpm target) as a conversion factor for this demographic, and this call opens with the customer explicitly failing to keep up.

key_moments.quote: I really wouldn't recommend solar panels for your home
key_moments.stewart_read: The rep disqualifies the home before completing any verify-section items — no interest question, no bill capture, no roof type/age discussion. This is a premature DQ built on a two-second satellite glance, skipping the hard-required qualification beat entirely.

key_moments.quote: I'm gonna ask someone else their opinion, and we shall see. Wait. Just give me a second.
key_moments.stewart_read: The rep puts the customer on hold for nearly a minute to consult a supervisor over what should be a routine qualification judgment call, not an unusual scenario like off-grid or manufactured housing. This also interrupts the hard-required verify_section beat mid-stream, leaving qualification incomplete when the rep returns with a supervisor-relayed answer instead of her own read.

key_moments.quote: Well, I I understand that you see nothing but trees when you look at pictures that are taken from the sky. But, I guess what I have to have is somebody who's willing to actually look at what's on I get, know what that is.
key_moments.stewart_read: The customer, in a halting and visibly frustrated turn, directly names the fix: someone needs to actually look at her property rather than rely on satellite imagery. This is effectively the customer handing the rep the exact next step (site visit / specialist referral) and the rep does not pick it up.
